name: Shipkasa
author: shipkasa

sections.description:
Shipkasa is the official WooCommerce integration designed for Shipkasa. It seamlessly connects your WooCommerce store to Shipkasa’s fulfillment network, enabling efficient order processing and automated tracking updates.

Third-Party Service Disclosure

This plugin relies on Shipkasa as a third-party service to function.
– Functionality: The plugin securely exposes order data to Shipkasa for fulfillment and receives tracking and shipping updates back from the service.
– Data shared: Order details (items, quantities, weights) and customer delivery information (shipping/billing addresses, name, phone, email) strictly required to fulfill and track shipments.
– Agreements: By using this plugin, you agree to Shipkasa’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Features:
* Secure Authentication Key API Access
* Exact Amazon Schema Compliance for Order Payloads
* Custom “Partially Shipped” Order Status Support
* Granular Tracking Data for Split Shipments
* Custom Tracking UI in the WooCommerce Order Admin
sections.faq:
How do I configure my credentials?

Go to WooCommerce > Shipkasa in your WordPress admin menu. Copy the generated Authentication Key and place it into your Shipkasa dashboard.

Does this support split shipments?

Yes! If Shipkasa fulfills only part of an order, the status updates to “Partially Shipped” and tracks which specific items were in each box.
